info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Ecommerce Cart Checkouts-v5-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Checkout Retrieval API enables developers to access and retrieve the list of checkout transactions for shopping carts within the ecommerce platform. This functionality is essential for tracking user activity during checkout processes, facilitating analytics, and enhancing user experience. Typical consumers of this API include frontend applications, data analysts, and third-party integrations seeking to monitor or report on checkout activities. By leveraging this API, businesses can gain insights into cart abandonment and optimize their sales strategies.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve the current checkout status and information in their shopping cart. It provides details necessary to proceed with the checkout process.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate the checkout process for the items currently in the cart. It should include all necessary details about the cart contents and any additional checkout preferences.

200.description: Checkout completed successfully with the current cart details.

ListEcommerceCartCheckoutsRequest.description: The request body for the GET operation on the cart checkout operations. This contains the serialized representation of the cart's checkout state.

status.description: Indicates whether the checkout operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the checkout operation.

resultId.description: The ID of the result of the checkout operation.

state.description: Current state of the checkout operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the checkout operation in milliseconds.

message.description: Descriptive message regarding the result of the operation.

ListEcommerceCartCheckoutsResponse_200.description: Schema representing the response for the checkout operations.

createdBy.description: The user who created the checkout operation.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the checkout operation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the checkout operation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Schema representing audit information of the checkout operation.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
